LogEntries.Entry: A hauler set down near the <Alias=DungeonLocation> was jumped on her run. The raiders left her the ship and took the cargo, a crate of water filters somebody is waiting for.
Raiders jumped a hauler and took her cargo, a crate of water filters, to the <Alias=FinalLocation>. She asked me to finish her run and take them to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>.
The raiders' leader at the <Alias=FinalLocation> had the crate of water filters. I took it back. It still needs to reach the <Alias=ThirdLocation>.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.
A hauler was jumped on her run and lost a crate of water filters to raiders at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. I got them back and finished the run to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the hauler at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>
Recover the filter crate from the <Alias=FinalLocation>
Deliver the water filters to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're not one of them, are you? Good. Then you can help, if you want to.
Somebody's been waiting a week to drink without boiling it first.
Don't bring it back to me. Take it where it was going.
Four of them. Very polite until they weren't.
They took the crate and left me the ship, which I suppose was kind of them.
I did. Someone's going to look into it next month. The filters were due last week.
Tall. A scar through one eyebrow. Laughed at his own jokes.
If he's worth something to you, take that as well. I won't miss him.
Easy. I've had enough visitors this week.
I'm fine, the ship's fine. The cargo isn't, and somebody's waiting on it.
